ns2:course.label: Study Abroad
ns2:course.description: Lectures, seminars, and practical work in French language, literature, civilization, and in other academic areas appropriate to the student's course of study. Maximum of 34 hours per academic year. Approved for both letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: FR 209 and two of the following: FR 205, or 207; 2.75 overall average; 3.0 average in French courses.
